Quick technical note on the load test planning:
- Environment: we can host the staging endpoint in us-west2; it will be isolated and short-lived.
- Auth: we’ll issue time-limited test API keys (expires 11/20). Please don’t use prod keys.
- Ramp profile we recommend: 60s warm-up, 10m steady-state at requested throughput (specify tokens/min), 60s cool-down.
- Observability: we’ll stream token-level traces to the console and provide a dashboard with p50/p90/p99 latencies, GPU utilization, and token throughput.

Attached is the loadtest-checklist.xlsx — includes a column where you can mark required prompts and dataset size. Two asks for Cygnus before we run:
1) Confirm which test endpoint to hit (their staging vs ours)
2) Provide an initial set of 30–50 sample prompts and expected acceptance criteria for correctness checks.

I’ll plan to stand up the staging cluster on Tue 11/16 afternoon so it’s ready for Wed 11/18.

—Dev
